pr_title: Override CompleteAsync() in StreamPipeReader to call Stream.DisposeAsync

issue_context.title: StreamPipeReader should override CompleteAsync
issue_context.body:
Along the lines of #64326, the [StreamPipeReader](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/src/libraries/System.IO.Pipelines/src/System/IO/Pipelines/StreamPipeReader.cs) class doesn't override `CompleteAsync`. 

As a result, if the inner stream `Dispose` methods blocks, the `CompleteAsync` call will end up blocking as well.

review_comments: Why is this only on NETCOREAPP?
Because `Stream.DisposeAsync()` isn't available on net462 or netstandard2.0
